narrative.overview: Inspection-document feel: navy masthead, white bordered panels, status color only where it means something. Single self-contained file, light/dark/print.
keyCharacteristics: Status carried by a labelled pill, never color alone

rules.name: The Status-Is-Labelled Rule
rules.body: A status color always travels with its text label in a pill.

rules.name: The Contrast-Is-Tested Rule
rules.body: Text meets 4.5:1 and focus 3:1 in both themes; tests enforce it.

rules.name: The Honest-Manual Rule
rules.body: An errored check is Manual Violet, never OK Green.

rules.name: The System-Font Rule
rules.body: No web fonts: the file must be self-contained.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows; use a border or tint step.

dos: Do lead with the verdict and worst items first.
Do pair every status color with its text label.
Do keep the file single and self-contained.
Do verify light, dark and print themes.
Do edit the parts and rebuild; never edit built scripts.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, animation or decorative imagery.
Don't introduce web fonts, icon fonts or external assets.
Don't show an errored check as OK.
Don't convey state by color alone.
